name: Jii
source:
An old man accompanying Larfa. He is about 120 centimeters tall and has a staff which is actually a laser swordstick. Although looks weak, Jii is pretty strong when he needs to be. He often floats in the air. 

[Translated from [url=http://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=125941]Getchu[/url].]
